Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 295 is more than a competitive total! Yes, the English batting is excellent but the Australian bowling is also very good and the wicket is a touch tacky. However, Morgan might just be expecting it to get easier under lights and if that is the case, Australia are probably 20 runs short. Whatever it may be, this promises to be a good second essay. Do join us in a bit.

England on the other hand, will be a little upset about how they went about especially after the way they started. Archer, Wood and Rashid bowled beautifully in the first half of this innings. They though had no answers to the Maxwell-Marsh partnership. However, they will be pleased with how they ended things. Wood was the star for them. Archer and Rashid were also very good. Woakes bowled a lot better than his figures indicate. Moeen Ali though looked a little off.

An excellent recovery from Australia! Yes, they probably haven't finished the innings strongly but after reeling at 123 for 5, they would take 294 with both arms open. This innings has been about the Marsh-Maxwell partnership for Australia. Yes, Stoinis played a good hand early on but it was the two who bailed the Aussies out of trouble. Both scored in the 70s and added more than 120. The visitors would have loved one of them to go on and get a ton but that was not to be. They though will be pleased with where they stand in the game at the moment.

SIX! Chris Woakes is livid with himself for that! Full length delivery on middle, Starc gets it out of the middle of his blade! Deposits it with disdain over cow corner for six runs. AUSTRALIA FINISH AT 294/9.
Josh Hazlewood is the next man in for the Aussies.

OUT! CAUGHT! Clever bowling from Woakes, he really deserved that! He realized that Zampa was struggling against his off cutters! Woakes bowls this back of a length around the off-stump, Zampa looked to heave that on the leg side but gets a top edge. Woakes moves to his left and holds on to that comfortably. He was struggling against Woakes, Zampa.
Play and a miss! Length ball around off, Zampa swings again but misses that completely.

Direct hit and Starc would have been a gonner! Starc taps this towards Morgan at mid off and sets off for a quick single. Morgan throws it in at the non-striker's end. Woakes fails to collect that properly and hence Starc makes it back in safely, for the single.
Just the one. Zampa pushes this full length delivery to cover-point. He gets only the single though. Good start from Woakes.

Swing and a miss! Zampa looked to swing wildly to the length delivery there. He misses, just like his partner at the other end. Once again, Buttler does well to collect that. It kept low as it approached him.
Chris Woakes to bowl the last over then for England.
Starc has a wild swing at the length delivery in the channel outside off. He though does not connect at all.

On off, Zampa looked to play at it but misses. He gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls over to the off side. A leg bye taken. Wood flicks the ball off his boots to the striker's end and hits but Starc was well in.
Guides the length delivery past cover. Just the single though.
Slower length delivery just outside off, Starc looks to cut but fails to read the slower one. He misses it and Buttler does well to dive and stop at that.

Wrong end there, the throw was at the striker's end but it should have been at the non-striker's end. Zampa guides this to Morgan at mid off and takes off for a quick single. Morgan throws at the wrong end, as Zampa was well short in running towards the non-striker's end. A single, in the end.
Starc digs this full length delivery to deep point and takes a single. Australia need more than singles though.

In the air...but falls safely from the man at backward point. Starc looked to keep this short ball down but ends up inducing a top edge. It falls safely from Morgan at backward point though and a single is taken in the end.
Zampa swings this away to long on for a single.
A knuckleball outside off, Zampa looked to put bat on ball there but fails to do so.
Zampa is off the mark with two. He works this past the cover fielder and calls for two. Starc agrees with him and two it is in the end.
Back of a length delivery, this is tucked away behind square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Starc is a very dangerous player at this stage of play. Archer misses the yorker line, ends up bowling a low full toss on the off pole, Starc whips that away to mid-wicket and collects a boundary.
Adam Zampa walks out to the crease now.

OUT! No bat and that is absilutely plumb. Three reds and Australia have lost both their reviews. This probably was more of one in hope. He is the last recognized batter and he was probably Australia's only hope to get to 300. Can't blame him for reviewing it. Wood goes wide of the crease and angles it into the middle pole. Marsh looks to work it across the line but misses to get hit on the pads. A huge shout and up goes the finger. Marsh reviews but to no avail. England finishing strongly.
Marsh is a goner! He has been adjudged LBW. Unless he has hit it, he is a goner.
Another two! Shorter and on middle, Marsh is late into the pull. It goes towards mid on and another couple results.
Another two! Extremely full and on middle, Marsh squeezes it through backward square leg.
Slips this one down the leg side, Wided.
Full and wide outside off, Starc throws his bat at it. It goes off the bottom edge down to third man for one.
One more short ball, on the body, this is pulled down towards fine leg for one.
Shorter, Marsh pulls it through square leg. It is in the gap so two results.
Starc lofts this full length delivery over mid on. It falls safely and the batters take a couple. More importantly, Marsh will be on strike in the next over!
Marsh pulls this short length delivery towards square leg for one.

DROPPED! It was a tough chance for Billings though, who came running in from deep mid-wicket! Starc skies the shorter ball high, as he looked to pull at that. It goes on top of the vacant short mid-wicket region. Billings comes running in, but cannot hold on to that, spills it in the very end. A single taken in the end.
Fullish and around off, worked to the leg side for a single.
Marsh looks to pull the shorter one but fails to connect and gets it on his body.
Mitchell Starc walks out to the crease at No.9.

OUT! CAUGHT! It went a long way in the air but did not get the distance which Cummins would have liked! It is a good comeback from Archer after being hit for two sixes by Maxwell earlier. Archer bowls a slow length ball outside off, Cummins looked to heave that on the off side but gets a top edge. It goes straight down the throat of Morgan at extra cover. Archer is laughing here, good comeback from him though!
A single as Cummins lifts this safely towards mid-wicket for one run.
Cummins gets a bottome edge as he looks to work that on the off side. It falls safely beside him. He looks for a single but Marsh says no.
A couple as Cummins works this length delivery towards Rashid at fine leg for two.
FOUR! Mid-wicket had just come up and hence it is smart batting from Cummins. Full length ball on middle, Cummins powers this through the carpet past mid-wicket and bags his first boundary.
Short and slow outside off, Marsh pulls it to the packed leg side and can only get one.
Cummins gets off the stike as he works this square on the off side for a single.
Mark Wood is back into the attack. His figures are 7-0-33-2.
He cannot keep strike and this is excellent comeback from Archer. Marsh can only defend this short length ball back on the track.
Bouncer in the channel outside off, Marsh sways away.
Cummins is off the mark as he taps this back of a length delivery to the off side for a single.
Pat Cummins walks out to bat now.

OUT! BOWLED! Ohh! Dragged on! Great comeback from Archer! Jofra bowls it on a length outside off, a touch slower than his regular pace. Maxwell looked to pull that one for another boundary, but he is beaten for the pace there. Gets a bottom edge, which deflects onto his woodwork. Maxwell is livid with himself, and rightly so. End of a very good knock from Maxwell, end of a brilliant partnership between him and Marsh. Also, he probably picked that. Archer changed his grip right at the end but Maxwell picked it. He just could not execute the shot. 300 now looks a little far fetched.

SIX! Another six, just a pick up and pressure is on Archer here! He bowls a low full toss on the pads, Maxwell was a little across to the off side but picks this on the full and deposits that over fine leg for a six.
SIX! With the wind, shorter boundary, that is very clever batting! Full length delivery on middle, misses the yorker and Maxwell launches that over cow corner for a biggie.
Jofra Archer is back in the attack. 7-0-30-1 are his numbers.
7 from that over, good bowling from Woakes! Maxwell works this full length delivery to mid-wicket for one.
Pulled firmly but straight to Billings at mid-wicket. Just the single.
Gets away with the full toss, Woakes. Bowls a full toss on the pads, Maxwell looked a little surprised there. He just manages to work that towards square leg and can get the single only.
Full and on the pads, Marsh flicks towards square leg for one.
Bangs a shorter one, it kept low. Maxwell pulls to deep mid-wicket for one.
Maxwell is quick and they will get two here! On the pads, flicked towards fine leg and Maxwell steams back in for the second.
Another single and that is 5 in total, good bowling from Rashid. Maxwell drives the fuller ball to long on and takes one.
Good over from Rashid so far, 4 singles from it. Marsh guides this flatter ball to point for a single.
Flighted full on off, Marsh blocks back.
Slower through the air outside off, Maxwell lifts that uppishly towards deep extra cover for one.
Marsh cuts the flatter ball to deep point. Again, just the one.
Flatter ball down the leg side, Maxwell eases that towards mid-wicket. Just the single.
A single to finish as Glenn works this towards mid on for one.
Another single as Marsh works this length ball towards mid-wicket for one.
Maxwell dabs this good length ball to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! That is a poor effort from Archer at mid on there! Length ball on the off pole, Maxwell lifts this towards mid on safely. Archer though puts in a lazy effort, does not dive to contain that. It goes past him to the long on region for a boundary.
Jumps and keeps the shorter one to Archer at mid on.
Length ball outside off, Maxwell finds cover-point on the drive.
Powerplay 3 signalled! Maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of the innings.
Maxwell works this to point and gets to the other end. He will keep strike in the next over.
Full and on off, worked to the off side for a single.
Tosses this full and outside off, Maxwell drives that towards point and takes one. Maxwell gets to his fifty. He has been good to watch so far!
SIX! Maxwell targets the shorter side of the boundary and gets what he wanted, a biggie! Tossed up full on the stumps, Maxwell lofts this high over cow corner for a maximum.
On the shorter side on middle, Marsh works that towards square leg for one.

FOUR BYES! So it is the work of the spin again! Adli loops this full and outside off, Marsh looked to drive at that but misses due to the spin on it. It beats the keeper and the slip fielder, again, and races away to the third man boundary.
A single to end! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A cutter on middle, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Good length and on off, defended.
FOUR! The 200 is up in style! Shorter and it sits up to be hit. Marsh says thank you very much and powers it through mid-wicket. No chance of stopping that.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the James Anderson end.
A single and that brings up the half ton for Mitchell Marsh. Looped up full outside off, Marsh eases this down to long off for a single.
Marsh punches that ball through the off side for a dot.
Looped up outside off, driven to extra cover for a single.

FOUR BYES! What has happened there? It has gone past everyone to the third man boundary for byes! Adil tosses this around off, the legbreak, it spins away, going past Maxwell who looked to sweep. It goes past Buttler and the slip fielder as well, bamboozling everyone and racing into the third man fence for a boundary off extras.
Tossed up way too full and outside off, Maxwell reaches out to it and drives that towards deep extra cover for two.
Loopy ball on off, worked towards Moeen Ali at long on for one.
Adil Rashid is back into the attack.
A single to finish as Marsh goes back and tucks this away behind square on the leg side for one.
Full on middle, Marsh clips this towards short mid-wicket for a dot.
Ali goes flat this time, Maxwell works it to the leg side off his back foot and gets to the other end.
Ali floats this full on middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
On leg, Maxwell goes back and pushes this towards square leg for one.
Floats this full on middle, Glenn tucks that towards mid-wicket.
Full length delivery on middle, Marsh defends towards mid on.
This time Maxwell is able to turn it down towards square leg and take a single.
Back of a length on middle, gets the top of Maxwell's front pad as he looked to work that on the leg side. It deflects and falls back on the ground.
A single as this is steered towards third man for one.
Back of a length delivery, Marsh defends this out off his back foot.
BEATEN! On a length around off, Marsh looked to guide that towards third man but fails to get bat on ball.
FOUR! This time he pierces the gap on the off side and gets a boundary. Full and outside off, he drives that powerfully in the gap at covers and gets another boundary.
Maxwell drives firmly but finds Morgan at cover.
On middle, Marsh strokes this to long on and gets to the other end.
Maxwell eases this to long on for a single.

FOUR! Maxwell got that one absolutely perfectly! He lets out a reverse sweep and gets that to the deep point fence and bags a boundary. And that brings up the 50-run partnership between these two as well! They need to go on. They have taken their side to safer shores but they would know the job is not done.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg for one run.

DRINKS! A good passage of play for Australia as Maxwell and Marsh are amidst a good stand! The two need to continue though as there is not a lot of batting after this. England on the other hand, will want to break this stand quickly and keep Australia to a low total. They are top now but will they continue to dominate?
Back of a length again, around off, Marsh works this towards point and collects one.
Comes in from wide of the crease and bowls a back of a length delivery around off, Marsh works that defensively towards mid on.
FOUR! It goes all the way for four, racing across the track! Fullish outside off, Marsh opens the face of his bat and steers that behind square on the off side for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Maxwell drives this past covers for a single.
A single this time as Marsh taps it beside on the leg side and sets off for a quick single. Gets it in the end as well.
Short and on top of off, Marsh looked to pull but cannot connect.
Oooh...good spin there! It lands on off and spins in sharply, Maxwell looked to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge to the leg side. A dot.
Floated full on middle, Maxwell defends from within the crease.
Slower through the air on middle, Marsh drives this to long on and takes a single.
A single as this is eased towards long off for one.
Full on middle, he blocks it back on to the track.
On off, Maxwell finds point on the drive.
Full around off, he drives this past covers and takes one.
Shortish on off, Maxwell works that towards point and says no to the single, after he himself came down the track a little.
Good length ball outside off, Maxwell cuts but finds point.
Lands on off, Maxwell kept that out by just.
A single as Marsh drives the fuller ball past point for one.
On a length around off, Marsh keeps that out.
Mark Wood is back into the attack. 4-0-22-2 are his figures.
Shortish and on middle, Marsh pulls it through mid-wicket for one more. Good over for the Aussies.
A single as this is worked square leg for one.
FOUR! A little too full and put away! This is a good partnership building for Australia. Tossed up on off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
On off, blocked.
A single as this is eased down to long on for one.
On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Moeen Ali is back in the attack.
Flatter outside off, Maxwell cuts this behind square on the off side for one run.
On the shorter side on the leg pole line, Marsh works this to the on side off his backfoot and runs to the other end.
On middle, defended back to Rashid.
Maxwell works this past the point fielder for a single.

SIX! Has Maxwell got it all the way? Yes, but only by just! Slower in the air on middle, Maxwell lofts this high in the air towards the deep mid-wicket fence. He just about gets it over the top of the fielder at the deep who stretched full to grab that but it went over his fingers and into the ropes for a maximum.
Flatter ball on the pads, tucked away behind square on the leg side for a dot.
On the pads, Maxwell flicks this away to square leg and will keep strike in the next over.
Marsh flicks this fuller ball to square leg for a single.
Good pace and bounce there from Archer! Bangs it short on top of the stumps, Marsh is taken aback from the sudden short one but sways away in time to let that go through to Buttler.
Marsh defends this one out towards mid-wicket for a dot.
FOUR! Absolutely muscled the drive there, Mitchell Marsh! Full and outside off, with a bit of pace taken off it. Marsh waits and then powers a drive through covers and bags a boundary.
Short and wide outside off, Maxwell cuts this to deep point and gets to the other end.
Firm drive by Marsh to this floated one but straight to the man at cover.
Flatter on middle, flicked towards square leg for one.
Marsh works this floated delivery past point for one.

A feeble appeal for LBW but it was going down the leg side. Adil flights it on the pads, Marsh looked to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads, which elicits an appeal from England. The umpire was not interested in that though.
On middle, Marsh blocks.
On the shorter side on the leg pole, Maxwell works this towards square leg for a single.
A leave to end as the lets this good length delivery, which was around the off pole to go through to the keeper.
Marsh defends this good length delivery to the off side for a dot.
BEATEN! Excellent bowling from Archer, a little bit of movement as the ball pitches on off and moves away a hint. It beats the outside edge of Marsh as he looked to defend that.
Short ball, seaming away a hint. Mitchell sways away from the line.
Full and on middle, Marsh drives that towards mid on.
WIDE! Need to reload Archer. Bowls a full length delivery way outside off. Wide has been called.
Shortish length delivery outside off, Marsh blocks it back on to the pitch and yells a loud no.
On off, defended.
Tosses it up nicely, Maxwell plays it back to the bowler.
Quicker and around off, Marsh plays it off the back foot through point for one.
Tosses it up on off, Marsh lunges forward and defends it nicely.
Shortish again, Maxwell slaps it through covers and takes one more.
Shorter and around off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On a length around off, Maxwell defends it out.
A slower delivery around off, Marsh works this towards the cover region for a single.
On a good length around off, Marsh fends this out towards the off side.
Marsh defends this to the off side off his backfoot.

OVERTHROWS! Maxwell taps this to long on and takes a quick single. The throw is at the striker's end and it is pretty wayward as Marsh gets in. The throw was so wayward that Buttler does not collect and neither does Root who went behind Buttler to back it up. It beats everyone to the boundary. 5 runs in total then!
Length ball on the off pole, Maxwell defends that out towards short cover.
Jofra Archer is back in the attack.
Full on off, worked back to Adil Rashid.
Marsh prods forward and pokes this to the off side.
Glenn Maxwell walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sweeps again, in the air, is it safe like last time? No! it is straight to Billings! Rashid has been all over the Australians in the previous series and he seems to be tormenting them now as well! Flights this on middle, a big stride from Carey as he looked to sweep at that. A top edge is induced again, but this time it goes straight into the hands of Billings at backward square leg. He takes it comfortably and Carey has to walk back.
Flatter on the stumps, worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Carey pushes the flatter ball to the leg side for one.
On off, blocked towards mid off.
Marsh presents the full face of his bat and defends this out.
On the shorter side again, Mitch defends.
Flatter outside off, Mitchell blocks it out to the off side.
Carey gets to the other end by pushing this shorter ball towards wide mid on for one.
Another single, this time from Marsh's bat. He goes back and taps this flatter ball towards deep square leg for one.
Flighted on off, Carey works this to wide mid on for a single.
Full and on off, Marsh finds mid on with the drive.
Carey cuts the flatter ball past point and takes a single.
Full on the stumps, Marsh works this towards long on for a single.
In the air...but safe! Rashid tosses this on middle, Carey looks to sweep but gets a top edge. It falls safely behind square on the leg side and a single is sneaked in.
Drops it way too short, Mitchell pulls firmly but straight to the man at deep square leg. Just the one.
Flatter on middle, Marsh guides that towards square leg.
On the shorter side, Marsh pushes this to the off side off his backfoot and takes a single.
On middle, Marsh blocks towards short mid-wicket.
Goes back and defends the flatter ball.
FOUR! Wow! What a shot, super shot from Marsh! Ali tosses this outside off, Marsh powers that through covers for a boundary.
Tosses this on the stumps, Marsh works it back to Ali.
On middle, Marsh taps this to the on side for a dot.
That is a beauty of a delivery to end a top over! Carey did not pick it at all. It is the googly on off, spins away sharply. Carey stays back and tries to block but is done in by the away turn.
Shorter and around off, it turns back in. Marsh has enough time to adjust, he works it through mid-wicket for one.
Carey plays the paddle sweep through short fine leg for one.
FOUR! That is the modern day batter! Comes out and straightaway plays the reverse sweep. Connects it well and hits it through point for a boundary.
Alex Carey walks out to bat.

OUT! No it is not! It is a bad review as three reds pop up! A very good decision by the umpire as we had a doubt it may have been slightly outside off. Rashid though strikes early in his spell and gets the wicket of Marnus who probably would have played the anchor role in the innings for the Aussies. The visitors slip further. This is tossed up outside off, it is the googly. Labuschagne does pick it. He tries to work it on the leg side with the turn but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Marnus reviews but replays show that the on-field call is the right one. He has to walk back and takes a review along with him. He also becomes England's leading wicket-taker in ODIs against Australia.
Do England have another? Labuschagne has been given out LBW. This could be a good review by him though.
Tossed up on off, it is pushed through covers for one.
Marnus goes back and defends this flatter ball towards mid on for a dot.
Tosses this around off, Marsh works this towards long off for one run.
Around off, Marsh comes on his front foot and blocks that out.
Tossed up on off, swept away towards deep square leg for a single.
Shouts of catch but it went to Morgan on the bounce! Flatter ball, Marnus rocks back and works this uppishly towards Morgan at short mid-wicket. It goes to the English skipper on a bounce.
Tossed up way too full, in the blockhole, outside off, Marnus looks to drive but gets an inside edge. The ball goes towards short fine leg and the batters take a couple.
Another shorter one, Marsh works this to the off side off his backfoot.
BEATEN! Flatter ball around off, Marsh looked to drive that on the off side but misses altogether.
FOUR! The googly there, but Mitchell Marsh picked it up early and well. Flatter googly on the stumps, Mitchell rocks back and works this behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
A single as Marnus works this loopy ball to square leg for one.
Tossed up on off, Marnus prods forward and defends this to the off side.
Adil loops this on the pads, Marnus sweeps with deft hands towards fine leg and bags a couple.
Adil Rashid to bowl now.

FOUR! Sweeps well does Marsh and this time Billings cannot do much. Looped up on the stumps, Marsh sweeps this towards deep square leg. It raced away to the fence for four and there was no chance for Billings to run in and cut that off.
On middle, Mitchell Marsh works this back to the bowler.
A couple as Marsh sweeps this tossed up delivery to Billings at deep square leg for two.
Loopy ball on off, kept low as it approached Mitchell. He keeps it out towards mid-wicket for a dot.
Shorter one this time, Labuschagne drives that to long off for one.
Moeen floats this on the pads, Marnus sweeps to fine leg for a couple.
He keeps out this back of a length delivery to the off side.
In the channel, Mitchell Marsh shoulders arms to that.
Labuschagne guides this length delivery towards third man for one.
Marsh is away as he works this length delivery to fine leg for one.
Mitchell Marsh is the next man in for the Aussies.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is the wicket that England wanted. Buttler takes a good diving catch. Back of a length delivery outside off, Marcus looks to drive but a thick outisde edge is induced. It goes to the right of Buttler, who does a good job to dive and hold on to it. Mark Wood is elated and England have netted a big wicket here. Stoinis walks off after getting off to a start. He was really looking good out there and growing in confidence. Timely wicket again.
Short again from Wood, but pulled very hard from Marnus. A single only as the ball went quickly to deep square leg.
A couple which means 8 from the over. A good one for Australia. This is outside off, Stoinis opens the face of the bat and guides it through cover-point for two.
Another defensive shot to this ball on off.
Quicker again and on off, Ali lunges forward and defends it.
Flatter now and on off, Stoinis pushes it to the right of the bowler.
FOUR! Up and over! Stoinis is looking really good out there. Moeen tosses it up but bowls it very full. It is lofted over mid off. No one behind and a boundary results.
Very full and outside off, this is jammed through covers for two.
On a length on off, Marnus defends this out to the man at first slip. He looked for a single but decides against it in the end.
Width on offer outside off, Marnus slashes hard at that. It goes thick and fast towards deep extra cover. Billings is quick to get to it. A couple.
Full around off, Marnus leans forward and drives that but straight to mid on.
A dot as he defends this length delivery to short mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Length delivery around the off stump line, Marnus looked to defend but the ball goes past his outside edge.
On off, Stoinis works this towards mid on and crosses over for a single.
On the pads, Marnus Labuschagne sweeps this towards deep backward square leg for a couple.
Shouts of catch it but it was hit safely. Floats this outside off, Marcus leans and drives that towards deep extra cover for a single.
Flatter ball on middle, Labuschagne goes back and works this to the leg side for one.
Full and on off, driven back to the bowler.

An appeal for LBW but it was outside the line of off-stump. Flatter ball on off, Marnus looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads outside of the line. He was hit way outside off-stump there!
Floated outside off, Stoinis drives this to wide mid off for one.
Time for spin! Moeen Ali to bowl now.
Stoinis works this towards mid on and takes a quick single.
FOUR! Stoinis got into a good position to play his shot there. Short length ball on top of off, he pulls this firmly behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
BEATEN! Good come back from Wood! It lands around off on a length and carries through quickly. Stoinis looks to defend but was beaten there.

EDGY FOUR! It was a genuine edge but a boundary nonetheless. Fullish and outside off, Stoinis hangs his bat in the channel, looking to drive. It takes a thick outside edge and goes to third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Stoinis seems to be enjoying his promotion at No.3. This one was on a length outside off, Stoinis drives this past Jason Roy at point and collects a boundary.
On off, Stoinis defends this to the off side.

FOUR! Beautiful shot from Labuschagne there. It brings up the 50 for Australia as well. Full on middle, Marnus times his straight drive really well. The timing was perfect and there was no chance for mid on to cut it off. First boundary for Marnus Labuschagne.
Full on the off-stump, Marnus taps that towards gully and looked for one but Stoinis was not interested there.
Full on the stumps again, Marnus blocks it out to mid-wicket.
Labuschagne defends this full length delivery to cover-point.
Good leave in the end from Marnus there! It pitches and comes in sharply towards off, Marnus though is aware of his off pole and leaves it alone. Well judged in the end.
Outside off, left alone.
Time for Powerplay 2! Now a maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the circle till the 40th over.

Squirted inside edge and a couple. Full around the off pole, Marnus looked to drive but gets it off the inner half of his bat. It goes to square leg and Rashid gives chase. A couple taken in the while.
Full length delivery, Marnus drives well, but Morgans runs in from mid on and intercepts that.

A single and Marnus is off the mark. Full on middle, he taps it beside on the leg side and calls for a quick one and runs to the other end. Stoinis too responds and runs in quickly to the striker's end. Good call and good running.
Bumper outside off, Labuschagne does not fiddle with that one.
Full on off, Marnus defends this out to the leg side.
Marnus Labuschagne walks out to the crease now.

OUT! CAUGHT! A faint nick and Finch does not wait for the umpire to raise his finger. England have their second breakthrough here and the change has ushered in a wicket immediately. Good length ball outside off, it pitches and seams away sharply. Finch looked to drive at that but the ball takes a faint outside edge. It goes to Buttler behind who holds on to it safely. Wood appeals but Finch is not waiting for the umpire, he knows he nicked it. Also, a rash shot by Finch. It was not quite there for the drive and also it zipped through a little. A good wicket as this partnership was looking nice.
Mark Wood is into the attack now.

FOUR! The outfield is quick and it beats the diving Morgan for a boundary. Full and outside off, Marcus drives that well. Morgan, at cover, dives but cannot contain it. It goes past and races to the deep cover fence for a boundary.
This time he takes a single as he works this good length delivery to square leg for one.
Good length ball on the stumps, Aaron Finch defends.

EDGED AND FOUR! There was only the one slip, no second or third slip and hence that will race away to the boundary. Length delivery outside off, Finch looked to drive on the off side but the ball takes a thick outside edge and goes past where second slip would have been to the third man region for a boundary.
Slower length delivery on leg, Marcus flicks this towards backward square leg and takes off for a single and gets to the other end.
Bangs it in short does Woakes, it does not bounce as much. It keeps low and Stoinis defends this out to the on side.
Short and on top of off, Finch jumps and defends this towards mid on.
Short and outside off, Aaron Finch does not play at it.

Stoinis does what his skipper did earlier, only that he was deep in the crease as he played that shorter ball. Stoinis goes deep inside his crease and taps the short delivery to short mid-wicket for a quick single. Archer runs in, collects and throws to the non-striker's end but Stoinis was well in.
Finch is outside his popping crease, hops and keeps the shorter ball towards short mid-wicket and takes a quick single.
Bowls a full length slower ball around the off-stump line, Finch drives this but straight to mid off.
In the channel outside off, the Australian captain leaves that alone.
A dot to finish as Stoinis taps this length delivery to the off side.
On a length on middle, Marcus defends this towards mid on.
Ooohs and aaahs there from England. That was close to the off-stump. Length ball around the fourth stump line, Marcus was aware of his off pole and lets that one through safely.
Full on the off stump, Marcus drives, but straight to mid off.
On a good length on the off pole, Stoinis looks to defend but gets it off the inner half of his bat. The ball goes past square leg for two.
On a length on off, Stoinis defends that towards the fielder at mid on.
Good delivery from Archer, bowls another short delivery to Finch. This time, Aaron leaves that alone. 4 runs off that over.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! Short length ball on top of the stumps, Finch controls the pull shot well, pulls it towards fine leg and gets a boundary.
Fuller on the off pole this time, Aaron defensively works this towards the man at cover for a dot.
Finch hops again, cuts this shorter length ball to cover-point once again.
Shortish length outside off this time, Aaron jumps and defends this towards point.
Digs in a shortish one, Archer. It keeps low though and Finch manages to keep it out.
Finch will keep strike in the next over as he works this good length delivery towards cover-point for one.
Follows the boundary with a single. Guides this length delivery to third man for one.

FOUR! He looks to be in super touch here, Stoinis! Woakes bowls it on the pads from wide of the crease, Stoinis just flicks that past mid-wicket. The fielder gives chase but the ball had enough on it to reach the ropes.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side, Marcus lets it go through and the umpire calls that a wide.
Good length delivery around the off pole, Aaron guides this towards mid off and takes a quick single.

A stifled appeal for LBW, nothing more. Fullish length ball on the pads, Finch closes the face of his bat a bit too early and gets hit on the pads as he looked to play at that. A very very mild appeal from England there but it was going down leg.
On the pads, Stoinis taps this to square leg and takes a single.
Good finish from Archer. Bowls a length ball outside off, it seams in a bit after pitching. Aaron shoulders arms to that. End of a successful over.
Outside off, Finch leaves that alone.
Just using the pace there, Stoinis. Fullish length delivery outside off, Marcus drives this beautifully through the off side and takes three as the cover-point fielder runs and cuts it off.
Good pace and good carry there! Short length delivery outside off, Marcus lets it through.
Bouncer to greet Stoinis! The batsman just about ducks under it.
Marcus Stoinis walks in at No.3 for Australia.

OUT! BOWLED! Absolute snorter! Well, Warner never looked comfortable at any stage. Length ball on middle, late movement outward, Warner looked to defend but misses completely. The ball goes past the outside edge and crashes into the stumps behind. Top of off to be precise. Excellent from Archer. England draw first blood then. Warner mumbles something to himself on the way back. Good start for the hosts.
Another block, as Aaron taps the fuller length ball straight to the man at short mid-wicket for a dot.
Full and around off, Finch defends it out to the off side.
A single this time as Warner works this fullish length delivery to fine leg for one.
And again, an action replay of the previous ball as Warner looks to cut but misses completely.
Loose shot from Warner there! On a length outside off, Warner looks to cut but misses. He does not read the pace well here.
Length ball around off, shaping in a touch. Warner deems it safe to let go and lets that one through.
A single to end as David pushes this fullish length delivery to wide mid off for one.
WIDE! Warner looks to the umpire and a wide is called. Archer bowls this waywardly outside off and it is wided.
Length ball around off, Warner defends it out.
In the channel outside off, Warner lets it go through to the keeper.
Length on the pads, Finch looked to turn it down on the leg side but misses. He gets hit on his pads and the ball goes to square leg. A leg bye taken there.
Oooh! Pace and bounce there. Took Finch by surprise. Short length ball outside off, pitches and goes through sharply. Finch just sways away from inside the line.
FOUR! The outfield is quick and it races away for a boundary. Fullish and outside off, Finch creams this past covers and gets off the mark with a boundary. First of the game.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side, Aaron lets it go through. Wided.
Jofra Archer to bowl from the other end.

Another couple! Warner punches this shorter ball past the fielder at cover and gets two. It should have been one but the fielder at cover ended up kicking the ball away from him by mistake and it ends in two. 4 runs off Woakes's first over.
Length ball on the pads, Warner looks to flick but misses. The ball gets the top of his pads and falls to the leg side.
A good, quick couple there! Good length delivery around the off pole, David looks to defend but gets an outside edge. The ball goes towards third man and Warner steams back in for a quick two.
Back of a length delivery on the fourth stump line, Warner shoulders arms to that.
In the channel outside off, Warner lets it be.
Woakes starts off with a length delivery around off, Warner defends this towards point.

We are all set for the action to begin! The England players are out in the middle. They are followed by the Australia openers, Aaron Finch and David Warner. The left-hander will take strike. Chris Woakes to start proceedings for England. Here we go...

Aaron Finch, Australia's captain, says that he is happy to bat first. Wants the team to bat well and put a big total on board. Says that Steve Smith is missing out as he had a blow to his head in the practice session earlier and has been rested as precautionary measure. Finch states that Labuschagne will slot in at No.3. On the preparations for the 2023 World Cup, Finch says that he is looking into the same, while the team will look forward to playing good cricket throughout. Adds that he looks forward to this ODI series very much.

Eoin Morgan, England's captain, says they want to bowl first. Reckons the track looks a bit slow and softer than when England played Pakistan recently. Lauds Malan's performance in the recently concluded T20Is. Also praises Adil Rashid's performance in the series earlier and says that he is a very useful spin bowler. So could Joe Root be, Morgan reckons. On Australia, Morgan says that they are a fanstastic side and very difficult to beat and therefore, England need to be on their toes throughout.
England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow, Joe Root, Eoin Morgan (C), Jos Buttler (WK), Sam Billings, Moeen Ali, Chris Woakes, Adil Rashid, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Marcus Stoinis, Marnus Labuschagne, Mitchell Marsh, Alex Carey (WK), Glenn Maxwell, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
Toss - The spin of the coin lands in England's favour. THEY WILL FIELD FIRST!

Hello and welcome from Manchester, for the 1st ODI between England and Australia. The hosts were clinical throughout, in the T20I series and took advantage of Australia's achilles heel - the batting, even in the last game, though England eventually lost it. How Australia would have worked on it will be interesting to watch! Definitely there would have been some hard conversations in the Australian camp surrounding this. The visitors would also do well to remember that Old Trafford traditionally favours the batters well and therefore, they would definitely look to take advantage of the same while having rectified their faults from the concluded series, earlier. Stay tuned for the toss and the teams updates.
